headline: Neutrino physicist wins 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics
summary: Francis Halzen won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics for leading development of the IceCube Neutrino Observatory. A companion piece quotes an IceCube researcher explaining the prize-winning neutrino-detection technology used under the Antarctic ice.

claims.statement: Francis Halzen won the 2026 Nobel Physics Prize for leading development of the IceCube Neutrino Observatory.

sources.quote: Neutrino physicist wins 2026 Nobel Physics Prize
Francis Halzen of University of Wisconsin-Madison led development of IceCube Neutrino Observatory.

claims.statement: An IceCube researcher explains the prize-winning technology used to detect cosmic neutrinos under the Antarctic ice.
